key_insight: CineCap introduces structured reasoning with spatio-temporal anchors to make cinematic video descriptions more accurate and more complete across film-language dimensions.
engineering_relevance: The method provides a practical path toward controllable video understanding and movie-quality generation by grounding captions in explicit visual evidence and reward-based refinement.
method: Uses spatio-temporal anchors to link cinematographic terms to visible evidence.
Organizes supervision into compact atomic reasoning for structured fine-tuning.
Applies reinforcement learning with comprehensiveness, accuracy, and gated coverage rewards.
evidence_signal: The paper evaluates on CineCap Bench, a manually annotated set of 472 video-caption pairs, and reports consistent gains over strong proprietary and open-source baselines.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of cinematic annotations and anchor grounding, which could be challenging to reproduce across diverse video domains.
paper_title: CineCap: Structured Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Anchors for Cinematographic Video Captioning
